meta.title: Invoice-Triggered Credit/Debit Note Suggestion: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role on the specified Growth tenant
Open and use Invoice-Triggered Credit/Debit Note Suggestion for an invoiced item missing from the PO
Observe and assert that the non-AP-Executive user is refused or does not receive the suggestion action
Repeat the workflow as an AP Executive and assert that the action is available
Verify the tenant's plan and RBAC configuration or determine whether access is deliberately granted to additional roles
